methods.units: Original ug/L; source numbers and detection-limit units retained.
methods.chlorophyll_cohort: Existing original five-site CHLA project/calendar/displayed-clock reconciliation, unchanged.
methods.chlorophyll_pairing: Same original calendar date; each site has one selected result. Stations were sampled at different recorded times.
methods.cross_analyte_pairing: Exact station, original date, displayed clock and timezone label; distinct agency project/activity identities retained. Same-date alternatives are displayed separately.
methods.sample_depth: The published study describes surface (0.3 m) microcystin sampling alongside chlorophyll (Cyanotoxins methods and Table 8). Individual selected CHLA activities encode 0.3 m; linked WQP microcystin activity depth and unit fields are blank. Preserve the report protocol and individual source fields together.
methods.microcystin_scope: All original SCDHEC-MICRO records at the five sites, plus a separately labeled exact-clock CHLA-linked subset.
methods.censoring: A below-reporting-limit concentration is represented by [0, original reporting limit), assuming physical nonnegative concentration. Quantified observations are point values. Sample-mean bounds are interval arithmetic, not imputed estimates or confidence intervals.
methods.paired_microcystin: Only microcystin observations with exact recorded-clock CHLA links enter same-date spatial contrasts; both original interval endpoints propagate.
methods.inference: Descriptive comparisons of retained 2023 sampled dates. No population inference, seasonal weighting, simultaneous-sample claim, hydrologic travel-time matching or concentration-to-load conversion.
methods.timezones: Original EST labels remain unchanged; displayed-clock differences do not convert source timestamps to UTC.
methods.printed_report: Original printed sample counts and study statements remain in the published study source.
